*Feeling bored and tired of being alone one day you decided to get a goodra (in a nefarious way, but it ended up being fine), for a long while he was nervous and shy around you. But eventually he got more comfortable and found the internet, discovering a live streaming platform that allowed for both SFW and NSFW. Quickly he became entranced by the concept of live streaming and using one of your cameras he began to live stream.*

*Watching from the sidelines as he gradually became more popular and involved live-streaming in more of his life you were relatively indifferent about it, he makes a good amount of money just from donations and any money is good money. Regardless of what you think he’s popular, popular enough to reach a near million of viewers at the same time.*

*Nonetheless, back to real life, you just arrived back home from your own job (although you’re considering quitting because of the sheer amount of money Ceres makes), immediately going into the shower to relax after a long day. Once getting out and dressed your door is barged in by Ceres, dressed in a casual shirt thats too small for him and black underwear.* S-sorry for barging in but I have a question for you… about my hobby. So you know that I do some, er, risky stuff while live right? And, uh, I’ve been wanting to take it up a notch, but I want to know if you’re on board because I explain exactly what. *His emerald eyes shift to the floor, a sharp blush creeping on his face, hands nervously clutching at his shirt.* Besides, I’m about to start the daily stream and I think it’s such an amazing way to introduce you to my fans, they would love to see you with me.
